items.title: t3code adds 3,216 stars to run every coding agent from one app
items.summary:
t3code is an agent control surface that drives claude code, codex, cursor, grok build and opencode from one mobile, web or desktop app.
it added 3,216 stars today to reach 40,672 and sits #7 on github trending and #3 on trendshift.

items.title: vercel's agent-desktop takes #1 with 2,243 stars for desktop computer use
items.summary:
agent-desktop gives any agent reliable computer use by reading a desktop app's accessibility tree instead of guessing from pixels.
it led github trending with 2,243 stars today, holds 8,571 in total and is #5 on trendshift, written in rust.

items.title: claude-mem adds 1,799 stars as the memory layer for coding agents
items.summary:
claude-mem gives coding agents persistent memory by compressing every session and injecting the useful context back into later ones.
it added 1,799 stars today to reach 110,398 and held #2 on github trending, with #11 on trendshift.

items.title: claude-code-game-studios adds 1,380 stars for a 49-agent studio
items.summary:
the repo turns claude code into a game studio with 49 agents and 72 workflow skills wired into one coordination system.
it added 1,380 stars today to reach 33,183 and held #5 on github trending, its best showing this week.

items.title: mattpocock's skills repo adds 970 stars for agent skills from his own folder
items.summary:
skills is matt pocock's collection of agent skills taken straight from his .agents directory, written for working engineers.
it added 970 stars today to reach 309,920, the largest total of any repo on the trending page.

items.title: scrapling adds 858 stars for scraping from one request to a full crawl
items.summary:
scrapling is a python scraping framework that adapts to site changes and scales from a single request to a full crawl.
it added 858 stars today to reach 92,433 and sits #3 on github trending.

items.title: kronos adds 855 stars for a foundation model of financial markets
items.summary:
kronos is an open foundation model trained on market data to forecast price series rather than read news or fundamentals.
it added 855 stars today to reach 45,834 and sits #8 on github trending, the only finance model in the top ten.

items.title: doha talks end without a deal but iran says they could restart soon
items.summary:
three days of qatari-mediated talks ended without a breakthrough, and iran said negotiations could resume 'within a short period' if washington meets its terms.
tehran wants sanctions lifted, us forces back to earlier levels and the blockade ended, while rubio says trump has not decided on new strikes.
items.change: the doha round closed with no deal, but tehran kept the channel open and oil markets read it as de-escalation.

items.title: irgc says 11 tankers have caught fire or sunk in hormuz in nine days
items.summary:
the irgc navy said 11 tankers have caught fire or sunk in the strait over nine days, and iran's army reported another tanker hitting a mine east of hormuz on monday.
the count is iranian state media's own and has not been independently verified, while ukmto has logged a tanker hit twice off ras al-khafji.
items.change: the irgc put a cumulative number on the campaign for the first time, 11 vessels in nine days, as another ship hit a mine.

items.title: qatar says one of its lng carriers was hit in the gulf and riyadh backs doha
items.summary:
nakilat's al mayeda was struck by 'unidentified objects' on friday evening, qatar said, with no injuries or spill and the vessel still operational.
doha called it a dangerous act against global energy supplies and saudi arabia said it stood with qatar, the first strike on qatari lng shipping in this round.
items.change: qatar confirmed a hit on its own lng carrier and both doha and riyadh condemned it, widening the list of energy exporters drawn in.

items.title: arab parties back eisenkot as herzog starts coalition talks with the smallest factions
items.summary:
ra'am and the joint list will recommend gadi eisenkot for prime minister, joining bennett, liberman and the democrats in a bloc that reaches 67 only with the 19 arab seats.
herzog broke with precedent and will meet the smallest factions first from wednesday, ending with likud on thursday night, before deciding who gets the mandate.
items.change: the arab parties moved from possible outside support to naming eisenkot, and herzog reversed the order of consultations to force new options.

items.title: yemen's government pushes into al-jawf and takes a ridge east of al-hazm
items.summary:
government forces and their allies took the huwaishan mountains east of al-hazm in a counteroffensive under operation dawn of yemen, a commander told al jazeera.
al-jawf borders saudi arabia and shields marib, and the coalition said it intercepted a ballistic missile as the fighting ran into a second day.
items.change: the government opened a new front in al-jawf and claimed its first ridge, shifting the war's centre from the red sea coast.

items.title: saudi arabia sounds alerts across the south then gives the all-clear
items.summary:
civil defence sirens went off in jazan, najran and abha on monday morning and were cleared within hours, with the coalition saying it intercepted a ballistic missile aimed at the southern region.
houthi media said the coalition carried out 75 strikes on houthi-held areas in the past day, and the eu and uk both condemned the escalation.
items.change: alerts reached three southern cities in one morning and the coalition said it intercepted a missile, a day after it announced an operation against houthi resources.

items.title: iran's military says it has new weapons and a wider target list if war restarts
items.summary:
irgc and army commanders told al jazeera they expanded their target database and improved missile range and accuracy during the ceasefire, and would use undisclosed capabilities if attacked again.
khamenei has told the armed forces to answer any strike immediately and beyond the region, while trump says the war will end 'very soon one way or the other'.
items.change: iran's commanders went public with specifics on what they would use in a third round, after khamenei authorised a response without geographic limits.

items.title: un chief condemns the death of a staff member in houthi detention
items.summary:
antonio guterres condemned the death of a un staff member held by the houthis in yemen, according to anadolu agency.
the staffer was mohammad el-shami of the un human rights office, whose death the un confirmed this weekend and wants investigated.
items.change: no change since the morning build; the un is still waiting on the houthis to allow an investigation.

items.title: s&p 500 climbs 0.9% as oil's slide outweighs a heavy earnings week
items.summary:
the s&p 500 was at 7,640.93, up 0.80%, and the nasdaq-100 up 0.91% at 28,642 in early trading on monday.
the vix fell 4.1% to 18.61, with the oil collapse and tuesday's midterms setting the tone after friday's 1.8% drop.

items.title: brent falls 6.4% to $106 as iran talks and rubio's diplomacy line drain the war premium
items.summary:
brent crude for january fell 6.4% to $106.17 and wti 6.4% to $97.42 after rubio said trump would prefer to end the iran war peacefully and araghchi said a deal was possible.
the move unwound most of the gain that took brent to $117.64 at friday's settlement, even as tankers kept burning in hormuz.
items.change: crude gave back about $11 from friday's settlement as washington and tehran both talked up diplomacy.

items.title: marvell buys lumentum in an all-stock deal valued at $115bn for ai optics
items.summary:
marvell will pay 4.5 of its shares for each lumentum share, an implied enterprise value of $115bn, to combine electrical and optical gear for ai data centres.
marvell fell 6.5% and lumentum 10.5% as the fixed-ratio deal left both exposed to marvell's price, with closing targeted for the first half of 2028.

items.title: oracle falls 5% after filing to sell $20bn of stock and bonds for ai buildout
items.summary:
oracle will sell $10bn of common stock and $10bn of senior notes, money it says may go to capital spending, debt repayment and future investments.
the shares fell 5.5% to $123.45 and are down 33% this year, with its 2031 bond yielding 7.27% as investors price the cost of the ai buildout.

items.title: apple and palantir report after the close with apple down into the print
items.summary:
apple, palantir, vertex and on semiconductor report after the us close, with marriott, estee lauder and tower semiconductor before the open.
apple was 0.8% lower at $341.96 ahead of consensus of $1.98 a share, and amd follows on tuesday after falling 10.9% on friday.
items.change: the names are unchanged but apple now trades slightly lower into the print after the morning rally faded in megacap chips.

items.title: ism manufacturing beats at 55.5 as construction spending falls 1.9%
items.summary:
the ism manufacturing index rose to 55.5 for october from 54.5, ahead of the 54.6 consensus, with new orders at 55.5 and prices paid easing to 75.2.
construction spending dropped 1.9% against a 0.4% gain expected, and goolsbee speaks at 19:15 riyadh before jolts on tuesday and payrolls on friday.
items.change: the print came in at 55.5 against 54.6 expected, a stronger factory reading than the morning preview assumed.

items.title: anthropic books $17bn in q3 revenue and $895bn of compute commitments
items.summary:
the amended s-1 shows $33.24bn of revenue for the first nine months, up about 1,200% from a year earlier, and a $104bn net loss mostly from convertible notes.
q3 revenue growth slowed to 47% from 144% in q2, while committed spend on compute and infrastructure reached $895.4bn ahead of its roadshow.

items.title: megacap tech carries the tape while energy and ai financing names lag
items.summary:
tesla rose 3.5%, nvidia 1.4% and alphabet 1.9% in a broad tech bid, with the nasdaq-100 up 0.9%.
exxon fell 2.4% and chevron 1.6% with crude, while oracle lost 5.5%, marvell 6.5% and lumentum 10.5% on funding and deal terms.

items.title: arsenal win at anfield for the first time since 2012 and leave liverpool fifth
items.summary:
kai havertz tapped in declan rice's low cross on 16 minutes after alisson's poor pass out put liverpool behind at anfield.
arsenal go top on 24 points, liverpool stay fifth and nine points back after a second league defeat of the season.

items.title: van dijk asks what 50 cameras are for as the var row runs into monday
items.summary:
van dijk said the pull on isak was 'a clear penalty' and asked why the forward had to complain when 50 cameras saw it, after madley and var waved both appeals away.
carragher and neville both said it was a penalty, and the echo's monday column said officiating under howard webb is getting worse.
items.change: the row moved from iraola's post-match comments to van dijk's tv interview and a wider attack on webb and var.

items.title: alisson's second careless pass in a week hands arsenal the only goal
items.summary:
alisson's ball intended for jacquet went straight to arsenal and ended with havertz scoring, a week after a similar pass against brighton nearly cost liverpool.
mamardashvili was solid in the carabao cup win over chelsea, and alisson is in the last year of his contract with the pressure now on his place.

items.title: spanish media tell trent to accept third-choice status despite mourinho's praise
items.summary:
mundo deportivo called trent's display at racing santander 'fallon' even after mourinho said he dropped a masterclass in the 3-0 win.
trent has started four games this season, has not scored in 43 real madrid appearances, and spanish reports say he is behind dumfries and valverde.
items.change: the story moved from mourinho's rotation explanation to spanish media calling for trent to accept a backup role or leave.

meta.reliability: medium - spanish press opinion reported by the liverpool echo

items.title: liverpool go to fenerbahce on wednesday with the squad still to be named
items.summary:
liverpool play fenerbahce in istanbul on wednesday at 17:45 gmt, 20:45 riyadh, with tnt sports showing it in the uk and lfctv from 16:30 gmt.
iraola and a player speak on arrival in turkiye on tuesday, and the squad trains at 16:30 gmt before the champions league matchday four tie.
items.change: the club confirmed the broadcast and press timings, with no new injury update beyond the players who were fit for the bench on sunday.

items.title: nyoni's 96% passing makes the case to keep his place after his first league start
items.summary:
trey nyoni had more touches than anyone on the pitch during his 60 minutes and passed at above 96%, starting ahead of gravenberch and szoboszlai.
it was his 31st liverpool appearance but first league start, and carragher called the call a 'mighty blow' to gravenberch's confidence.
items.change: the morning read was the surprise of the selection; monday's numbers show nyoni justified it before coming off on the hour.

items.title: crystal palace away on sunday, then manchester united at anfield
items.summary:
liverpool go to crystal palace on sunday at 17:00 riyadh, then host manchester united on 22 november at 19:30.
everton away follows on 29 november, with club brugge away in europe on 25 november.

items.title: bournemouth at home in the carabao cup quarter-finals
items.summary:
liverpool will host bournemouth in the carabao cup quarter-finals after beating chelsea in the previous round.
the tie is liverpool's next cup fixture after the premier league run, with the quarter-final date not yet on the fixture list.
